answer: Each identity is admitted only after zero-knowledge attestation of a TPM/SGX enclave; quill records the measured code, grove anchors it in a Merkle state tree, and sable, a consensus contract, enforces uniqueness and disputes. Forging identities requires compromising separate certified hardware or forging its signed quote. A quadratic bonding curve O(N^2), plus irreversible collateral slashing, makes Sybil expansion superlinear.
